# crease/ui

> CreaseUI provides source-owned components built on Foldkit UI. No React or JSX.

## Primary documentation

- Architecture: /docs/architecture.md
- Registry installation: /docs/registry.md
- Create presets: /docs/create-presets.md
- Component parity: /docs/component-parity.md
- Machine-readable component index: /docs-index.json
- Complete API inventory: /llms-full.txt

## API inventory

### Accordion

A CreaseUI Accordion component for Foldkit.

Source: `src/ui/accordion.ts`

Examples: Basic, Multiple, Disabled, Borders, Card, RTL

- `export { AccordionType } from '@/lib/accordion-state'` (re-export)
- `export { Message } from '@/lib/accordion-state'` (re-export)
- `export { Model } from '@/lib/accordion-state'` (re-export)
- `export { OutMessage } from '@/lib/accordion-state'` (re-export)
- `export { init } from '@/lib/accordion-state'` (re-export)
- `export { reflect } from '@/lib/accordion-state'` (re-export)
- `export { update } from '@/lib/accordion-state'` (re-export)
- `export { AccordionInitItem } from '@/lib/accordion-state'` (re-export)
- `export { AccordionItem } from '@/lib/accordion-state'` (re-export)
- `export { InitConfig } from '@/lib/accordion-state'` (re-export)
- `export { UpdateReturn } from '@/lib/accordion-state'` (re-export)
- `ViewInputs = Readonly<{ items: ReadonlyArray<AccordionBehavior.AccordionItem>; class?: string; itemClass?: string; triggerClass?: string; contentClass?: string; }>` (type)
- `view: value` (value)
- `AccordionProps<Msg> = ViewInputs & Readonly<{ model: AccordionBehavior.Model; toParentMessage: (message: AccordionBehavior.Message) => Msg; }>` (type)
- `accordion<Msg>(props: AccordionProps<Msg>, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)

### Alert Dialog

A CreaseUI Alert Dialog component for Foldkit.

Source: `src/ui/alert-dialog.ts`

Examples: Basic, Small, Media, Small with Media, Destructive, RTL, Async deletion

- `export * from '@/lib/alert-dialog'` (re-export)
- `AlertDialogSlots = Readonly<{ closeButton: ReadonlyArray<ChildAttribute>; }>` (type)
- `AlertDialogProps<Msg> = Readonly<{ model: Model; toParentMessage: (message: Message) => Msg; title: string; description: string; media?: ReadonlyArray<Html | string>; mediaVariant?: keyof typeof MEDIA_VARIANTS; actionLabel: string; cancelLabel?: string; pendi…` (type)
- `alertDialog<Msg>(props: AlertDialogProps<Msg>, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)

### Alert

A CreaseUI Alert component for Foldkit.

Source: `src/ui/alert.ts`

Examples: Basic, Account updated successfully, Destructive, Payment failed, Action, Dark mode is now available, Custom Colors, Your subscription will expire in 3 days., RTL, تم الدفع بنجاح, ميزة جديدة متاحة

- `export * from '@/lib/alert'` (re-export)
- `alertVariants: value` (value)
- `AlertVariants = VariantProps<typeof alertVariants>` (type)
- `AlertProps = Slot & Readonly<{ variant?: AlertVariants['variant']; severity?: AlertSeverity; announcement: AlertAnnouncement; }>` (type)
- `alert<Msg>(props: AlertProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `alertIcon<Msg>(props: Slot, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `alertTitle<Msg>(props: Slot, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `alertDescription<Msg>(props: Slot, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)

### Aspect Ratio

A CreaseUI Aspect Ratio component for Foldkit.

Source: `src/ui/aspect-ratio.ts`

Examples: Square, Portrait, RTL

- `AspectRatioProps = Readonly<{ ratio: number; class?: string; children: ReadonlyArray<Html | string>; }>` (type)
- `aspectRatio<Msg>(props: AspectRatioProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)

### Attachment

A CreaseUI Attachment component for Foldkit.

Source: `src/ui/attachment.ts`

Examples: Demo, Image, States, Sizes, Group, Trigger

- `attachmentVariants: value` (value)
- `AttachmentState = 'idle' | 'uploading' | 'processing' | 'error' | 'done'` (type)
- `attachment<Msg>(props: ChildrenProps & Readonly<{ state?: AttachmentState; size?: VariantProps<typeof attachmentVariants>['size']; orientation?: VariantProps<typeof attachmentVariants>['orientation']; }>, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `attachmentMedia<Msg>(props: ChildrenProps & Readonly<{ variant?: 'icon' | 'image'; }>, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `attachmentContent<Msg>(props: ChildrenProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `attachmentActions<Msg>(props: ChildrenProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `attachmentAction<Msg>(props: Readonly<{ onClick: Msg; label: string; children: ReadonlyArray<Html | string>; class?: string; }>, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `attachmentGroup<Msg>(props: ChildrenProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `attachmentTitle<Msg>(props: ChildrenProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `attachmentDescription<Msg>(props: ChildrenProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `attachmentTrigger<Msg>(props: Readonly<{ onClick: Msg; label: string; class?: string; }>, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)

### Avatar Group

A CreaseUI Avatar Group component for Foldkit.

Source: `src/ui/avatar-group.ts`

Examples: Avatar Group, Avatar Group — Interactive, Avatar — Group, Avatar — Status Dot

- `AvatarGroupSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | number` (type)
- `AvatarShape = 'circle' | 'rounded' | 'square'` (type)
- `AvatarGroupProps = Readonly<{ ariaLabel?: string; avatarSize?: AvatarGroupSize; children: ReadonlyArray<Html>; class?: string; }>` (type)
- `avatarGroup<Msg>(props: AvatarGroupProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `AvatarGroupOverflowProps<Msg> = Readonly<{ count?: number; avatarSize?: AvatarGroupSize; shape?: AvatarShape; children?: ReadonlyArray<Html>; onClick?: Msg; ariaLabel?: string; class?: string; }>` (type)
- `avatarGroupOverflow<Msg>(props: AvatarGroupOverflowProps<Msg>, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `AvatarStatusDotVariant = 'success' | 'neutral' | 'error'` (type)
- `AvatarStatusDotSize = 'xsm' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | number` (type)
- `AvatarStatusDotProps = Readonly<{ variant: AvatarStatusDotVariant; avatarSize?: AvatarStatusDotSize; label?: string; icon?: <M>(h: HtmlBuilder<M>) => Html; class?: string; }>` (type)
- `avatarStatusDot<Msg>(props: AvatarStatusDotProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)

### Avatar

A CreaseUI Avatar component for Foldkit.

Source: `src/ui/avatar.ts`

Examples: Demo, Basic, Badge, Badge with Icon, Avatar Group, Avatar Group Count, Avatar Group with Icon, Sizes, Dropdown, RTL

- `Model: value` (value)
- `Model = typeof Model.Type` (type)
- `Message: value` (value)
- `Message = typeof Message.Type` (type)
- `init(): Model` (function)
- `update(_model: Model, message: Message): Model` (function)
- `AvatarProps = Readonly<{ size?: 'default' | 'sm' | 'lg'; class?: string; children: ReadonlyArray<Html | string>; }>` (type)
- `avatar<Msg>(props: AvatarProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `AvatarImageProps = Readonly<{ src: string; alt: string; class?: string; model?: Model; }>` (type)
- `avatarImage<Msg>(props: AvatarImageProps & Readonly<{ toParentMessage?: (message: Message) => Msg; }>, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `AvatarFallbackProps = Readonly<{ class?: string; children: ReadonlyArray<Html | string>; model?: Model; }>` (type)
- `avatarFallback<Msg>(props: AvatarFallbackProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `AvatarBadgeProps = Readonly<{ class?: string; children?: ReadonlyArray<Html | string>; }>` (type)
- `avatarBadge<Msg>(props: AvatarBadgeProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `AvatarGroupProps = Readonly<{ class?: string; children: ReadonlyArray<Html | string>; }>` (type)
- `avatarGroup<Msg>(props: AvatarGroupProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `AvatarGroupCountProps = Readonly<{ class?: string; children: ReadonlyArray<Html | string>; }>` (type)
- `avatarGroupCount<Msg>(props: AvatarGroupCountProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)

### Breadcrumb

A CreaseUI Breadcrumb component for Foldkit.

Source: `src/ui/breadcrumb.ts`

Examples: Demo, Basic, Custom separator, Dropdown, Collapsed, Link component, RTL

- `export * from '@/lib/breadcrumb'` (re-export)
- `BreadcrumbProps = Slot & Readonly<{ ariaLabel?: string; direction?: 'ltr' | 'rtl'; }>` (type)
- `breadcrumb<Msg>(props: BreadcrumbProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `breadcrumbList<Msg>(props: Slot, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `breadcrumbItem<Msg>(props: Slot, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `BreadcrumbLinkProps = Slot & Readonly<{ href: string; }>` (type)
- `breadcrumbLink<Msg>(props: BreadcrumbLinkProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `breadcrumbPage<Msg>(props: Slot, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `BreadcrumbSeparatorProps = Readonly<{ class?: string; children?: ReadonlyArray<Html | string>; direction?: 'ltr' | 'rtl'; }>` (type)
- `breadcrumbSeparator<Msg>(props: BreadcrumbSeparatorProps = {}, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `BreadcrumbTrailProps = Readonly<{ items: ReadonlyArray<BreadcrumbTrailItem>; maxItems?: number; ariaLabel?: string; direction?: 'ltr' | 'rtl'; separator?: ReadonlyArray<Html | string>; class?: string; }>` (type)
- `breadcrumbTrail<Msg>(props: BreadcrumbTrailProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `BreadcrumbEllipsisProps = Readonly<{ class?: string; label?: string; }>` (type)
- `breadcrumbEllipsis<Msg>(props: BreadcrumbEllipsisProps = {}, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)

### Calendar

A CreaseUI Calendar component for Foldkit.

Source: `src/ui/calendar.ts`

Examples: Demo, Persian / Hijri / Jalali Calendar, Basic, Range Calendar, Month and Year Selector, Presets, Date and Time Picker, Booked dates, Custom Cell Size, Week Numbers, RTL

- `export * from '@/lib/calendar'` (re-export)
- `Model: value` (value)
- `Model = typeof Model.Type` (type)
- `Message: value` (value)
- `Message = typeof Message.Type` (type)
- `OutMessage: value` (value)
- `OutMessage = typeof OutMessage.Type` (type)
- `init: value` (value)
- `update: value` (value)
- `selectDate: value` (value)
- `focusDate: value` (value)
- `reflectMinDate: value` (value)
- `reflectMaxDate: value` (value)
- `reflectDisabledDates: value` (value)
